amniotic fluid fluorescence polarization (AFFP) values are more accurate than the lecithin/sphingo‐ myelin (L/S) ratio in predicting fetal lung maturity and respiratory distress syndrome (RD S) and are easy to obtain.

the use of amniotic fluorescence polarization measurements to establish fetal maturity is a reliable index for predicting fetal lung maturity and is also a useful tool for assessing the risk for developing neonatal respiratory distress syndrome.
